p: The phase schedule spreads draft compute across the paired target timeline and eliminates the measured forbidden overlaps. It does not fully hide draft compute, and the full sweep does not demonstrate an overall throughput improvement over the previous schedule. Standard EAGLE3 also loses to target-only decoding on this low-acceptance workload. The new schedule remains an opt-in research path.

The next useful experiments are duration-aware placement and finer tiling of the long draft-attention kernels, together with reducing the cost of split target verification and dependent draft stages. More graph-node subdivisions alone have already plateaued. Native SGLang TBO requires a supported GPT-OSS expert-parallel operation path before cases b/d can yield performance measurements. Any attempt to restore programmatic dependencies needs token-level equivalence tests in addition to a short accuracy smoke test.

Reproduction commands, all batch/context statuses, model snapshot revisions, source hashes, both-rank traces, timing repetitions, and failed-experiment diagnostics are preserved in the archives. Source and report commit links are recorded in the completion index.
